name: lambda.site.template
description: lambda.site.template — vanilla Astro on top of a Lambda backend, with Capacitor mobile shells
author: https://github.com/papag00se

scripts.dev:content: nodemon --watch frontend/src --watch frontend/public --watch astro.config.mjs --ext astro,mdx,md,njk,js,jsx,css,json --exec "npm run build:content"
scripts.build:frontend: rm -rf frontend/dist && npm run build:content && npm run build:js && cp frontend/$APP_ENV${APP_ENV:+.}env.js frontend/dist/env.js
scripts.sync:android: (export APP_ENV=android; npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync android)
scripts.sync:ios: (export APP_ENV=ios; npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync ios)
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:browser
